environment.description: Same Ktor microservice deployed in namespace 'platform-tools' on EKS 1.28. A Cilium-managed NetworkPolicy (CiliumNetworkPolicy CRD) is applied at the namespace level with a default-deny egress posture. Explicit egress allowances are defined only for TCP/53 to kube-dns (label k8s-app=kube-dns), TCP/443 to endpoints labeled app.kubernetes.io/part-of=backend-services, and TCP/5432 to the RDS endpoint via CIDR 10.0.48.0/20. The policy uses entity-based rules with 'world' denied and no allowance for the link-local CIDR 169.254.0.0/16. Additionally, the node group has IMDSv2 enforced (HttpTokens: required, hop-limit: 1) which prevents container-level metadata access even if network egress were possible. Pod runs under a restricted PodSecurityStandard with no hostNetwork access.

config.link_local_access: denied (169.254.0.0/16 not in any allow rule, default deny applies)
